title: Photorealistic cinematic close-up selfie
prompt:
Photorealistic cinematic close-up selfie portrait of a young adult woman in her early twenties, approximately 20 years old, with facial features visually consistent with an East Asian appearance, relaxing indoors on a comfortable sofa in a softly illuminated modern living room. Captured from a slightly elevated, intimate handheld selfie perspective, with her face occupying the upper central portion of the frame and her shoulders, collarbones, and upper torso filling the foreground.

She has a delicate oval-to-heart-shaped face, softly rounded cheeks, a gently tapered jawline, a petite straight nose with a softly rounded tip, and naturally full, coral-rose lips forming a subtle, warm, closed-mouth smile. Her large, expressive dark brown almond-shaped eyes feature glossy catchlights, carefully defined upper eyelashes, subtle eyeliner, softly blended neutral eyeshadow, and naturally shaped eyebrows. Her fair, luminous skin has delicate peach-pink undertones, smooth but realistic texture, subtle rosy blush, and gentle highlights across her forehead, nose, cheeks, shoulders, and collarbones. She gazes directly into the camera with a relaxed, affectionate, quietly playful expression.

Her dark chocolate-brown hair is styled in a voluminous, chin-to-shoulder-length layered bob with softly feathered ends, a slightly tousled silhouette, and airy, wispy bangs sweeping diagonally across her forehead. Individual strands frame her cheeks and jawline, while the ends curl gently inward around her neck.

Her slender upper body is angled slightly toward the camera, with her head tilted gently downward and sideways. One arm extends diagonally toward the lower-left foreground, suggesting she is holding the camera for a casual selfie, while her other arm bends upward, with her hand resting lightly against the side of her hair near her ear. Her shoulders remain relaxed, creating a spontaneous, intimate composition.

She wears a fitted black camisole-style top with thin spaghetti shoulder straps and contrasting pale ivory trim along the neckline and strap edges, exactly exposing her shoulders, upper chest, and collarbones. A delicate fine-chain silver necklace rests against her skin, featuring a small, polished, deep-red triangular pendant centered below her collarbones. A subtle dangling earring is partially visible beneath her hair.

Soft natural daylight enters from a window on the left, creating luminous highlights and gentle shadow transitions. Behind her, a charcoal-gray upholstered sofa and pale neutral wall appear softly out of focus, establishing a calm domestic atmosphere. No additional accessories or garments.

Shot with a 35mm equivalent smartphone portrait lens, close focusing distance, natural perspective distortion, realistic skin rendering, shallow background separation, fine hair detail, subtle photographic grain, soft highlight roll-off, and gentle cinematic diffusion. Color grading combines warm ivory skin tones, muted chocolate-brown hair, neutral gray surroundings, and soft pastel highlights. Authentic candid lifestyle photography, refined Japanese-inspired beauty editorial aesthetic, natural proportions, high dynamic range, ultra-detailed photorealism, 4K quality, horizontal 4:3 aspect ratio.
